optimization_velocity.stage_rationale: 17 iterations, 21 entries. Two entries now battle-tested (7ca56b8b, 056f0a9e), one developing (06920986). ~54% tasks seen. Strong upward metric trend iters 10-16 (0.0556→0.5000) with single-iteration dip iter 17 (0.2778). optimization_velocity.recommendation: The iter 17 dip is likely batch variance given the strong 4-iteration upward trend preceding it. Focus on: (1) testing whether the graduated 1f931f4e format improves commitment compliance — this is the single biggest failure mode (exhausting budget without submitting). (2) Investigating 056f0a9e's +3/-3 to identify which sub-rules cause harm. (3) Continuing to let the 14 untested entries get natural exposure rather than rewriting them. The commitment/self-check layer is the weakest — consider whether passive self-assessment triggers should be replaced with more concrete, action-forcing formats.
